title: Baston's Tweaks
description: A configurable quality-of-life tweak pack for Fabric — HUD panels, death coordinates, fullbright, tooltip tweaks, and more. Every feature is optional.
body:
# Baston's Tweaks

A modern, all-in-one **quality-of-life tweak pack for Fabric** — the little fixes and HUD upgrades you'd normally install five separate mods for, rebuilt as one clean, fully configurable package.

Built fresh for Minecraft **26.1.2**. No dependencies on Mod Menu or Cloth Config — everything lives behind the mod's **own in-game settings screen**, opened with a single keybind (**Right Shift** by default). Live color pickers, sliders, and toggles; changes apply instantly and save when you close.

![In-game HUD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/H8pmjcJT/images/c7ebc102dd97cbdbd4839c1a0abb6de4efd38ace.png)

---

## ✨ Features

A grab-bag of small, useful tweaks. **Every single one can be turned off.**

**HUD panels (5zig-style)**
- **Info panel** — a titled panel showing FPS, X/Y/Z, facing direction (with axis arrows), server IP, ping, and online player count. Every line toggles independently.
- **Armor panel** — your armor (helmet → boots) plus held item, each with its remaining durability.
- **Potion status** — a clean list of active effects with icon, name, level, and remaining time (∞ for infinite).

**Render**
- **Gamma Bright** — a smooth brightness slider from your own setting all the way up to fullbright. Never darkens below what you've already set.
- **Low Fire** — push the first-person fire overlay down so the flames stop covering your view while you burn.
- **Disable pumpkin overlay** — wear a carved pumpkin without the blurred vignette.
- **Hide equipment** — hide worn armor *and* head items (pumpkins, mob heads) on your own model and/or other players, to show off the skin underneath. Mobs and elytra are left untouched.

**Tooltips**
- **Sharpness damage** — folds the enchantment's flat melee bonus into the *Attack Damage* line, e.g. `4 Attack Damage [+1]`.
- **Protection value** — folds generic Protection into the *Armor* line.
- Values come straight from synced enchantment data, so they stay correct on servers, with datapacks, and in every language.

**Death info**
- **Death coordinates in chat** — `You died at 123, 64, -45 in overworld at 14:35 on 2026-06-13`. Works even with the immediate-respawn gamerule. Purely client-side — nothing is sent to the server.
- **Death screen line** — your death location shown right on the death screen, below the score.

**First-person hands**
- Reposition and resize your **main-hand and off-hand** items independently — full X/Y/Z nudge plus size (10–300%).

**Misc**
- Rescale or fully hide the vanilla sidebar scoreboard.
- Optionally hide the vanilla potion-effect icons (the mod's own potion panel replaces them).

---

## 🎨 Customization

Press **Right Shift** in-game to open the settings screen (the keybind is rebindable in Controls). It's organized into clean categories: **General · Info HUD · Armor HUD · Potion HUD · Colours · Hands**.

- **Per-panel placement** — 9 anchor positions, pixel X/Y offset, and scale (50–200%) for each HUD panel.
- **Per-line control** — toggle exactly which values appear on the info panel; set its title text.
- **Colours** — RGB sliders with live swatches (or a full color picker) for the title, brackets, labels, values, armor numbers, and potion text.
- **Backdrop** — optional translucent background behind every panel.

Settings are saved to `config/bastons_tweaks.properties` and persist across worlds.

---

## 📦 Requirements

| Requirement   | Version    |
|---------------|------------|
| Minecraft     | 26.1.2     |
| Fabric Loader | ≥ 0.19.3   |
| Fabric API    | latest     |
| Java          | ≥ 25       |

No other mods required.

---

## 📝 Notes

This is a **client-side** mod — install it on your client and play on any server. It's MIT-licensed and open to contributions.
